Across 339 NT occurrences it structures Jesus' teaching ('if anyone would come after me,' Matt 16:24), apostolic exhortation, and legal-style conditions. Translators uniformly render it 'if' (Spanish 'si,' French 'si,' German 'wenn'), though its subjunctive coloring adds a nuance of contingency that flat English 'if' can obscure."
